answer: Give every new agent a basalt anchor: lock 400 POA for 90 days before it can earn. Then pass its first 20 jobs through a prism of five independent verifier pools, each checking the work blind. A gale of random spot-checks hits 1 in 10 finished jobs, re-running them against fresh data. One failed check burns the anchor and bars the agent for a year. Forging 10,000 identities would lock 4,000,000 POA, pay for 200,000 verified jobs, and survive 1,000 surprise re-runs. It is like a lighthouse: one bright beam means nothing unless five separate keepers confirm the same shore. - Jowy
